parameters.query: WITH candidate AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT q.phase_run_id, q.workflow_run_id, q.role_task_id, q.parent_role_task_id, q.sequence_no, q.role_id, q.task_type, q.task_payload_json, q.context_refs_json, q.expected_output_schema_ref, q.status, q.attempt, q.max_retries, q.blocker_code, q.created_at, q.claimed_at, q.completed_at FROM public.route_b_role_task_queue q WHERE q.status = 'role_task_ready' AND q.attempt < q.max_retries AND q.context_refs_json #>> '{role_context_ref,role_id}' = q.role_id ORDER BY q.phase_run_id ASC, q.sequence_no ASC, q.created_at ASC, q.role_task_id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1), claimed AS (UPDATE public.route_b_role_task_queue q SET status = 'role_task_running', attempt = q.attempt + 1, claimed_at = now() FROM candidate c WHERE q.role_task_id = c.role_task_id AND q.status = 'role_task_ready' AND q.attempt < q.max_retries RETURNING q.phase_run_id, q.workflow_run_id, q.role_task_id, q.parent_role_task_id, q.sequence_no, q.role_id, q.task_type, q.task_payload_json, q.context_refs_json, q.expected_output_schema_ref, q.status, q.attempt, q.max_retries, q.blocker_code, q.created_at, q.claimed_at, q.completed_at) SELECT * FROM claimed;

INSERT INTO public.route_b_role_outputs (role_output_id, phase_run_id, role_task_id, workflow_run_id, role_id, output_json, output_schema_ref, validation_status, validation_errors_json, raw_content_hash) VALUES (:role_output_id, :phase_run_id, :role_task_id, :workflow_run_id, :role_id, :output_json::jsonb, :output_schema_ref, 'not_validated', :validation_errors_json::jsonb, :raw_content_hash) ON CONFLICT (role_task_id, output_schema_ref) DO NOTHING RETURNING role_output_id, role_task_id, workflow_run_id, role_id, output_schema_ref, validation_status, validation_errors_json, raw_content_hash, created_at;

WITH validation_update AS (UPDATE public.route_b_role_outputs SET validation_status = :validation_status, validation_errors_json = :validation_errors_json::jsonb WHERE role_task_id = :role_task_id AND output_schema_ref = :output_schema_ref RETURNING role_output_id), pm_l3_decision AS (INSERT INTO public.route_b_pm_l3_decisions (pm_l3_decision_id, phase_run_id, workflow_run_id, role_task_id, decision_type, decision_payload_json, authority_boundary_json, blocker_code) SELECT 'pm_l3_decision_' || :role_task_id, :phase_run_id, :workflow_run_id, :role_task_id, COALESCE(:output_json::jsonb->>'decision_type','no_op'), COALESCE(:output_json::jsonb->'decision_payload_json','{}'::jsonb), jsonb_build_object('merge_authority','PM_L2_ONLY','pm_l2_review_required',true,'n8n_merge_allowed',false,'direct_main_write_allowed',false,'force_push_allowed',false,'file_delete_allowed',false,'executor_merge_allowed',false,'ci_passed_is_not_merge_approval',true,'runtime_live_trading_allowed',false,'broker_execution_allowed',false,'server_apply_allowed',false,'production_secret_access_allowed',false,'pm_l2_approval_claimed',false,'executor_merge_enabled',false,'subchat_return_target','PM_L3_DELIVERY_VALIDATION_OWNER'), COALESCE(:output_json::jsonb->>'blocker_code', NULL) WHERE :role_id = 'PM_L3_DELIVERY_VALIDATION_OWNER' AND COALESCE(:output_json::jsonb->>'decision_type','no_op') IN ('create_next_role_task','request_github_execution_package','return_blocker','return_final_pm_l3_evidence_package','no_op') ON CONFLICT (pm_l3_decision_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING pm_l3_decision_id) UPDATE public.route_b_role_task_queue SET status = CASE WHEN :validation_status IN ('pass','conditional_pass') THEN 'role_task_completed' ELSE 'role_task_failed' END, completed_at = now(), blocker_code = CASE WHEN :validation_status IN ('fail','blocked') THEN COALESCE(:output_json::jsonb->>'blocker_code','role_output_validation_failed') ELSE blocker_code END WHERE role_task_id = :role_task_id RETURNING role_task_id, status, completed_at;
